name: make the bucket publicly readable via an access policy
definition: Alternatively attach a bucket policy that allows the public principal to view objects in the bucket, which the verifier accepts
failure_mode: A policy that doesn't match the principal/action/resource pattern fails.

name: merge divergent branches and resolve conflicts
definition: merge the second branch into the base branch, resolving all conflicts so the working tree is consistent.
failure_mode: unresolved conflict markers or a deleted file break parsing of the artifact

name: modify a C project build configuration to emit LLVM IR for all translation units
definition: Adjust compiler invocation (flags/driver) in a build so each source unit is compiled to LLVM IR rather than native machine code, across the whole project.
failure_mode: Build still produces native code or no IR-format file is produced

name: move documents into per-class directories and empty the source directory
definition: Relocate each file to a folder for invoices or others, leaving the original document container empty.
failure_mode: Any leftover or misplaced file breaks hash-set equality.
